// description: Minimal setup for running ImProcess as a stand-alone post-acquisition processor with the MoNaLISA reconstruction pipeline. No hardware devices are declared - this setup is meant for opening existing acquisitions (HDF5/Zarr/TIFF), reconstructing them, and saving the result. Set processing.graphPanel to false to hide the optional graph panel. To use, also set 'enabled' to ['improcess'] in modules.json.
